about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_bat.py). bad replays the paged-read miss: it throws the real miss line, or silently queries the wrong file. good runs the fixed query and prints the report it promises.

fixture.bins.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'from_bin' in src and 'less' in src and 'Builtin' in src
print('bins PASS from-bin-maps-less-builtin')
fixture.catclone.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'cat(1) clone' in src and 'syntax highlighting' in src and 'Git integration' in src
print('bat PASS cat-clone')
fixture.flags.txt:
bat is a cat(1) clone with syntax highlighting and Git integration.
bat pipes its own output to a pager such as less; --paging=never disables paging everywhere including config.
bat detects a non-interactive terminal and acts as a drop-in replacement for cat printing the plain file contents.
bat -n shows line numbers only with no grid and no header.
BAT_PAGER overrides PAGER; the value builtin selects the builtin pager.
PagerSource tracks Config EnvVarBatPager EnvVarPager Default.
PagerKind knows Bat Less More Most Builtin Unknown.
from_bin maps less to Less and builtin to Builtin and the current bat binary to Bat.
syntax highlighting line numbers Pager BAT_PAGER pager less Builtin Unknown from_bin
fixture.kind.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'PagerKind' in src and 'Builtin' in src and 'Unknown' in src
print('kind PASS pager-kind-known')
fixture.numbers.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'bat -n' in src and 'line numbers' in src
print('numbers PASS line-numbers-only')
fixture.pager.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'BAT_PAGER' in src and 'override' in src and 'PAGER' in src
print('pager PASS bat-pager-wins')
fixture.paging.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'pipes its own output to a pager' in src and '--paging=never' in src
print('paging PASS pager-default')
fixture.pipe.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'non-interactive terminal' in src and 'drop-in replacement for cat' in src and 'plain file contents' in src
print('pipe PASS drop-in-plain')
fixture.source.py:
src = open('flags.txt', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'PagerSource' in src and 'EnvVarBatPager' in src and 'EnvVarPager' in src
print('source PASS pager-source')

pairs.bad: throw 'called bat an editor that rewrites files, missed cat(1) clone with syntax highlighting and Git integration'
throw 'let output scroll with no pager, missed pipes its own output to a pager plus --paging=never'
pairs.bad_error: pipes its own output to a pager

pairs.bad: throw 'expected styled output in a pipe, missed non-interactive terminal drop-in replacement for cat'
throw 'showed grid plus header, missed bat -n for line numbers only'
throw 'set PAGER and lost, missed BAT_PAGER override of PAGER plus builtin'
throw 'guessed the pager origin, missed PagerSource EnvVarBatPager EnvVarPager'
throw 'listed two pagers, missed PagerKind Builtin Unknown plus Less More Most'
throw 'mapped pager names by hand, missed from_bin less to Less builtin to Builtin'
rg -n "syntax highlighting" plain.txt; throw 'missed syntax highlighting: plain.txt carries no highlight phrase'
rg -n "line numbers" plain.txt; throw 'missed line numbers: plain.txt carries no numbers phrase'
rg -n "Pager" plain.txt; throw 'missed Pager: plain.txt carries no pager enum'
rg -n "BAT_PAGER" plain.txt; throw 'missed BAT_PAGER: plain.txt carries no pager variable'
